This tutorial collects the mathematics behind
[Fundamentals of Machine Learning](../fundamentals-of-machine-learning/index.qmd). It covers notation, linear algebra, probability and statistics,
optimization and information theory, followed by the technical lemmas and inequalities that the learning theory proofs
use.

## Chapters

- [Mathematical and statistical foundations](mathematical-and-statistical-foundations.qmd)
- [Appendices and technical background](appendices-and-technical-background.qmd)

Works cited are listed at the end of each chapter.
